replies.author: rinn
replies.body:
Hello Justin,

Unfortunately, I have decided to deny your appeal. Although there is no evidence for your ban, you have admitted to hacking on our servers, and I ask for you to wait a few months before making another appeal. Although you may regret your actions, it is best that you wait a significant amount of time as a banned user without being caught ban evading or causing trouble on other platforms to show us that you are ready to play on our servers again.

Regards,
Rinn | Senior Moderator
